notes.note: #0.9-16 are the tail of the 15-slot leader block #0.2-16 (TextIdOffset+1+k). 0655.bla chain 10,9,8,6,7,15,14,5,4,3,13,12,11,2,1 = 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1; wording confirms (#0.10 Shotaro 'nee', #0.11 Momotaros 'doita doita'). So #0.9 OOO, #0.12-14 Taro/Seven/Ultraman (identical JP), #0.15 RX, #0.16 Rider 1. Dropped subject of 'no time' restored as 'we' (the party).
Tieren Taozi = Soma Peries (g=f) refusing to retreat. 'Chouhei' = 'Super Soldier(s)' as in earlier slices.
Ankh to the arriving Ahead Smultron; 'mada iyagaru' = there are still more of them (Smultrons met earlier). Smultron is g=n -> 'these things'.
Ankh after the fight; dropped subject read as the battle ('That took more effort').
#0.2-16 leader block, all identical JP -> identical EN.
Not called by 0658.bla (TextIdOffset+16 unused); speaker unknown, kept neutral. 'Koitsu' = Regnant (g=n) -> 'this one'; precedent: Ribbons made Regnant an Innovator.

#0.23-36 leader block (TextIdOffset+22+k), same chain order as 0655: 00, Wing Zero, God (#0.25 'tough opponent'), Nu, Zeta, Zero (#0.28 'yagatta'), Mebius (#0.29 polite), OOO, W (#0.31 'ne'), Momotaros (#0.32), Taro/Seven/Ultraman, RX (#0.36). Rider 1's slot (#0.37) does not exist in the table. 'Kibu' rendered 'the Colony Laser's base' (base section of the weapon), not the hideout sense of 'base' (kyoten).

#0.2-16 leader block, same chain order: 00 ('you da na'), Wing Zero ('kakunin dekinai'), God, Nu ('laser oscillator'), Zeta, Zero, Mebius (desu ne), OOO (#0.9), W (#0.10), Momotaros (#0.11), then 5 identical. 'Sorerashii setsubi' = equipment you'd expect for a Colony Laser -> 'equipment of that kind'.
Reborns Gundam (Ribbons): mocking, casual 'kai/yo/sa' -> light taunting tone.

#0.26-40 leader block (TextIdOffset+25+k), same order. 'Da to iu no ka!!' rendered as a question 'Are you saying...!?'. #0.33-34 (OOO, W) add a pause, kept as '...'. #0.35 Momotaros 'ii kagen ni shiro yo' -> 'Gimme a break!!'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped via 0655/0658/0659 Pt_Chara_Check chain (00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1), confirmed by wording. Uncertain: 0658 #0.17 unused line, speaker unknown; 0658 block lacks Rider 1's slot; 'kibu' -> 'the Colony Laser's base'. Not in glossary: Super Soldier and Innovator (both used earlier), Smultron as short form of Ahead Smultron, laser oscillator.
